stated_vs_actual_gap: A massive disconnect emerged between stated preferences and actual behavior. Many customers said they had a 'slight preference' for breed-sorted photos, but then admitted they don't follow Pawfect's Instagram and would never see the change. The stated preferences were essentially meaningless because they were theoretical responses to content these customers never consume.
baseline_summary: Current customers are moderately satisfied (average 6-7/10) but loyal primarily because their dogs are comfortable at Pawfect. They value the personal relationships groomers have built with their pets over everything else. While switching would be a mild hassle, most stay out of convenience and their dogs' familiarity with the staff, not strong brand loyalty.
